  • Method Details

    • of

      public static PerformancePeriodMetrics of(ReturnSeries series, MoneyWeightedReturn.Result mwr, int expectedSessions, List<PeriodStep> steps, double feesMC)
      Builds the figures from the calculated series and converts every ratio into a rounded percentage.
      Parameters:
      series - time-weighted series of the report, including the excluded base as first point
      mwr - result of the internal rate of return search
      expectedSessions - expected trading days in the period
      steps - all period steps of the report; only complete ones with a return are ranked
      feesMC - fees booked in the period, a charge is positive
      Returns:
      the figures of the period

    • of

      public static PerformancePeriodMetrics of(ReturnSeries series, MoneyWeightedReturn.Result mwr, int expectedSessions, List<PeriodStep> steps, double feesMC, int skippedFees)
      Builds the figures including the count of fee bookings without a conversion rate.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
